name: Manufact

team.summary: Pietro and Luigi, cofounders of Manufact (formerly mcp-use), building open source SDKs for Model Context Protocol (MCP) since April 2025.

product.summary: Manufact is an MCP vertical cloud (Vercel-for-MCP) that handles hosting, cross-client testing across ChatGPT and Claude, publishing checks for app stores, cloud inspection, and analytics for MCP apps and servers.

market.summary: Dev teams and tech companies building MCP apps and servers for AI chat platforms and agent marketplaces.

risks.risk: Skepticism in the community regarding whether MCP is a durable protocol or a passing trend / dead end compared to CLI tools and skills.
Potential platform risk if major AI hosts (OpenAI, Anthropic) change protocol specs or absorb hosting/testing natively.

founder_depth.why: Founders have been building open source MCP SDKs (mcp-use) since April 2025, demonstrating deep domain expertise and prior shipped open-source tools with significant adoption.

shipping_evidence.why: Fully live product with 10M+ SDK downloads, 10k+ GitHub stars, production templates, active cloud platform deployment, and documentation.

demand_signal.why: Strong HN engagement (111 points, 70 comments), named customers like PredictLeads, AgentMail, and Meilleurtaux, and active developers reporting long-term usage.

defensibility.why: Built on top of an open-source framework and protocol (MCP) with several competing frameworks emerging (like Skybridge), though capturing the deployment, testing, and compliance workflow creates stickiness.

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: Manufact is an AI infrastructure and developer tool platform providing hosting, testing, and deployment for Model Context Protocol (MCP) apps and servers used by software engineering teams.
analysis.case_summary: Strong open-source developer adoption and comprehensive product surface for MCP workflows, countered by debate over the long-term architectural durability of MCP.
would_change_my_mind: Major AI clients build native hosting and store compliance tools that bypass third-party MCP clouds.
Developer migration away from MCP toward raw CLI tools or custom skills accelerates permanently.
Net revenue retention or paid enterprise conversion rates stall.
data_gaps: Exact revenue figures or paid customer count.
Founders' prior professional background and exits before mcp-use.
